description: This file defines the TaxonomyContentsAdminListDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and update logic for taxonomy content lists in an OrchardCore module, including filtering and hierarchical term population.

classes.name: TaxonomyContentsAdminListDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for managing taxonomy content list display and filtering in the admin interface.

classes.name: FilterTermEntry
classes.description: A helper class representing a taxonomy term with display text, content item ID, and hierarchy level.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Builds the taxonomy filter UI for the admin list, including hierarchical term population.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes filter selections from the UI and updates the route values accordingly.

methods.name: PopulateTermEntries
methods.description: Recursively populates a list of term entries with hierarchy levels from content items.
